edit_ops.detail: Every channel goes through the same scalar curve f(x) = aces(pow(x*e*wb_c, contrast))^(1/gamma) of one variable, so the whole tonemapper is three 1D lookups. The LUT is built on the CPU per uniform set (256 entries over log2 x in [-10, 8]) and sampled with linear filtering; only the log2 mapping stays in the shader.
